Risks: This is a source code change to the crate root. The key semantic change: previously the crate was unconditionally `no_std` — so any accidental use of `std` would fail to compile in any build. Now, `no_std` is gated on `not(test)`, meaning under `cfg(test)` (unit tests) the crate links std. This weakens the guarantee: code paths only compiled under test (e.g., `#[cfg(test)]` modules, or code reachable only in test builds) could use `std` items without error, so tests could pass while the actual `no_std` build fails — a silent regression in no_std compatibility that CI might not catch unless it runs a non-test build (e.g., `cargo build --no-default-features` on a no_std target, or `cargo check` for a bare-metal target).
